purpose: Attach read-only Cohesion C3-11 treatment options to deterministic BOOT-MB claimed-lane holds without executing or overriding any treatment or claim decision.

excluded: generic shared-frontier failure without deterministic fresh conflict

ordering: BOOT-MB mechanism evaluates shared-current claim state
BOOT-MB activation establishes final pre_dispatch standing
if deterministic claimed-lane hold, call C3-11 through the already-instantiated Message Board runtime

refresh.path: existing refresh reconstructs through self.bootstrap and therefore receives the same projection wrapper
refresh.stable_decision: identical active conflict set + candidate identity => stable C3 decision_digest
refresh.anti_churn: projection does not write Message Board; already-fresh repeated held refresh leaves Git head and board bytes unchanged
refresh.routing: BOOT-MB routing digest remains the coordination change detector; treatment projection is a deterministic explanation of that held state

replica.explicit_allowed_replica: Message Board may return ALLOW; no hold projection is attached
replica.option_only_on_primary_conflict: REPLICA treatment is only a non-authoritative future option until a lawful Message Board REPLICA claim is made

acceptance: exact duplicate BOOT-MB hold carries C3 exact-duplicate treatment projection
self active incompatible hold carries self-conflict treatment projection
treatment options have no execution authority
projection creates no candidate presence or board event
ALLOW, READ_ONLY and DISABLED paths have no projection
generic shared-frontier hold has no fabricated deterministic C3 projection
explicit allowed REPLICA remains governed by Message Board and unprojected
repeated identical held refresh has stable decision digest and no board write
package extension is installed without adding a second RPC/tool namespace
successor: Rehydrate Cohesion P0 and current claims; if unowned, choose the next C3 steering residual rather than assuming tool 12 remains free
